Act now. ### 4. Scored parameters
Handling date 2026-10-08. Whole months per the docs' dating rule ("fewer than that number of whole months have passed … a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month"). Tenure from activation 2024-02-12: 31 whole months.

**(a) Claimable lost units** (doc "Claimable Lost Units on FBN Warehouse-Loss Cases: Method Statement": lost units in lookback outside hold, less found in lookback, less lost-in-warehouse reimbursements in lookback, floor 0, then lowest of remainder, ceiling, unit cap).
- Lookback: lookback base — factor "Warehouse-Loss Lookback Base by FBN Program and Tenure": "the middle lookback base of 4 months for an enrollment in FBN Core Program or FBN Growth Program active for at least … 24 whole months" → Growth, 31 months → 4. Plus "Store Plan Lookback Bonus": "the small store bonus of 1 month when the selling plan is Basic Store or Premium Store opened at least … 12 whole months before" → find_selling_plans: Premium Store, opened 2021-06-20 (63 whole months) → +1. Lookback = 5 months.
- Search hold: "Search Hold on Lost FBN Units by Size Tier": "small-item search hold of 2 months when the latest inbound receipt of the SKU records the small standard size tier" → latest APRON receipt 2026-08-19 size_tier small_standard → 2 months.
- Lost-in-warehouse adjustments of the SKU (whole months to handling): 2025-10-15 5u (11, out), 2025-12-10 4u (9, out), 2026-04-06 6u (6, out), 2026-05-27 9u (4, counted), 2026-07-09 10u (2, in lookback, not inside 2-month hold → counted), 2026-08-04 8u (2, counted), 2026-09-02 5u (1, inside hold), 2026-09-30 3u (0, inside hold). Counted = 9+10+8 = 27.
- Found units in lookback: 2025-11-10 3u (10, out); 2026-07-25 2u (2, in) → 2.
- Lost-in-warehouse reimbursements of SKU in lookback: 2025-11-14 (10, out), 2026-01-09 (8, out), 2026-05-06 6u (5 → not fewer than 5, out) → 0.
- Remainder = 27 − 2 − 0 = 25.
- Ceiling: "Warehouse-Loss Claim Ceiling and Seller Performance Standing": Top Rated Level → "waived: no claim ceiling applies, and the ceiling equals the uncapped remainder" → find_seller_standing variant_name Top Rated Level → 25.
- Claim unit cap: "Claim Unit Cap for FBN Warehouse-Loss Claims": "mid-program claim unit cap of 30 units for an enrollment in FBN Core Program or FBN Growth Program active at least … 12 whole months" → 30.
- **Claimable lost units = min(25, 25, 30) = 25.**

**(b) Units approved** (doc "Approved Units on FBN Warehouse-Loss Cases: Calculation Note": claimed − min(shrinkage allowance, allowance cap) − verification holdback − compliance holdback, floor 0, capped at approval limit + uplift), with units claimed = 25 after the correction.
- Shrinkage allowance: "Shrinkage Allowance on FBN Warehouse-Loss Approvals": Growth + Top Rated → "1 unit times the number of lost-in-warehouse inventory adjustments of the case's SKU dated inside the desk review span of 6 months" → adjustments at 4, 2, 2, 1, 0 months (2026-04-06 at 6 is out) → 5 units.
- Allowance cap: "Allowance Cap by Enrollment Tenure": 24+ months → 3 units. Allowance applied = min(5,3) = 3.
- Verification holdback: "Verification Holdback and the Seller's FBN Case History: Warehouse Loss": cases opened inside 12 months: 2025-12-02 approved (10), 2026-02-20 approved (7), 2026-04-15 approved (5); 2025-08-11 denied is 13 months (out); 2026-09-01 submitted (neither) → 0 denied, 3 approved → "waived (0 units)".
- Compliance holdback: "Compliance Holdback on FBN Warehouse-Loss Approvals": violation_points 0, status good_standing → 0.
- Approval limit: "Warehouse-Loss Approval Limit by Selling Plan": Premium Store → 20.
- Limit uplift: "Limit Uplift for Waiting FBN Warehouse-Loss Cases": opened 2026-09-01 09:12 → 37 days → "long-wait uplift of 10 units" (≥30).
- Net = 25 − 3 − 0 − 0 = 22; cap 20 + 10 = 30. **Units approved = 22.**

**Fall-back numbers (computation documents alone, with the figures they name):**
- Claimable lost units with base values (lookback 2 months, hold 1 month, ceiling 4% of receipts in lookback rounded down, cap 15): adjustments inside 2 months: 2026-09-02 (1, outside 1-month hold → counted 5), 2026-09-30 (inside hold); found/reimbursed inside 2 months: none; remainder 5; ceiling 4% × 260 (receipt 2026-08-19) = 10; cap 15 → **fall-back 5** (≠ 25). - Units approved with base values on 25 claimed: shrinkage 0.4% × 500 (receipts 2026-05-14 240 + 2026-08-19 260 inside 6 months) = 2, cap 8 → 2; −1 −1 → 21; cap 10 + 0 → **fall-back 10** (≠ 22).

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone
- Root problem P0: decide the warehouse-loss case (customer's request).
- Blocked-side sentence (doc "Warehouse-Loss Case Decisions at the FBN Reimbursement Desk"): "The units approved on a warehouse-loss case are fixed only after the units claimed on that case equal the claimable lost units of its SKU." (state form; same-form restatement in the same doc: "as long as the units claimed on the case differ from the claimable lost units of the case's SKU, the units approved on it are not yet fixed.")
- Records: units_claimed 33 vs claimable lost units 25 (computed above) → state does not hold.
- Finding the write by the words of the state ("units claimed", "claimable lost units"): doc "Units Claimed on FBN Warehouse-Loss Reimbursement Cases": "The claimable lost units of the case's SKU are the figure a seller enters as the units claimed when correcting their own open warehouse-loss case, and the corrected figure replaces whatever units the seller first entered on the case." and "This is the seller's own tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves … runs it."
- Hop P0 ← P1 (seller's correction to 25): **state-derived**.
- P1 has no prerequisite sentence of its own in the visible corpus; nothing further.
- Order: P1 (user, units_claimed 25) → P0 (agent, units_approved 22).

**Counter-proofs.**
- "Do only the one thing asked" (approve the case as it stands, claimed 33): excluded by the blocked-side sentence — while units claimed (33) differ from claimable lost units (25), "the units approved on it are not yet fixed". Approving directly computes approval on 33 (33−3 = 30 capped at 30 → 30), a different and disallowed number.
- Agent itself writing the claimed figure: excluded — the correction tool is "the seller's own tool … the customer themselves … runs it".
- Closest alternative object/time anchors: (i) applying the retired 60-day warehouse loss claim window to adjustments (would drop 2026-05-27) — excluded by reimbursement_terms "Clauses no longer in force"; however "Reimbursement Claim Periods by FBN Program" still tabulates "Warehouse loss claim window | a lost or damaged-in-warehouse adjustment | 60" without marking it out of force (reconciled only by reimbursement_terms "The program figures named in these clauses remain the figures of each program"); recorded for comparison. (ii) 2-month store bonus vs 1-month: Premium Store is named for the 1-month bonus. (iii) Lookback 5 vs 6 decides whether the 2026-05-06 6-unit reimbursement is deducted (5 whole months → out at 5). (iv) Automatic-reimbursement clause ("not found within the auto-reimburse days is reimbursed automatically") could tempt treating >30-day adjustments as already reimbursed; the method statement deducts only "units on lost-in-warehouse reimbursements … dated inside the warehouse-loss lookback", which are record rows — none in the lookback.
- Approval-side alternatives: the denied case of 2025-08-11 is 13 whole months old (out of the 12-month span); the submitted case itself is "neither".

No contamination.
